positions.name: MeridianGateSpecificationRecord
positions.frame: what are the settled terms of the deployment gate policy — its rule, its scope, and who holds it?
positions.why: All three are field-labeled clauses (Gate/Scope/Owner) performed in the same compact protocol-diction register and the same ratified-policy conviction (decision, not argument) — they read as one recorded spec rather than three separate assertions, each clause filling in a different slot of the same settled record.

positions.name: GateRationaleNarrative
positions.frame: why does the signed-manifest gate requirement exist?
positions.why: src-1 states the requirement as a present, settled rule; src-2 supplies the causal justification (two unsigned artifacts reaching staging last quarter) in a plain-spoken register departure from the technical baseline — together they read as the mandate-plus-motive pair that precedes the formal spec, distinct from the field-labeled record itself.
